components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one solid yellow action (Copy, Start), with its glow and keycap.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 50px; padding: 0 10px 0 18px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: linear-gradient(#FFE14D, #FFD60A, #F5C400); color: #000; font: 600 14px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.55), 0 2px 18px rgba(255,214,10,0.5); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: scale(1.03); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(255,214,10,0.6); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-keycap { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.12); font: 700 11px ui-rounded, system-ui; }

components.name: Dock Island
components.description: A glass capsule of 40pt tools with the sliding yellow puck under the active one.
components.css: .ds-island { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 5px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.6); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.6), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.22), 0 10px 36px rgba(0,0,0,0.22); } .ds-dock-btn { width: 40px; height: 40px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: #1d1d1f; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-dock-btn:hover { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.07); } .ds-dock-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFD60A; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-dock-btn.ds-on { background: linear-gradient(#FFE14D, #FFD60A); color: #000; box-shadow: 0 2px 18px rgba(255,214,10,0.5); } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-island { background: rgba(40,40,44,0.55); } .ds-dock-btn { color: #f5f5f7; } .ds-dock-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07); } }

components.name: Toggle Dock Button
components.description: A titled toggle (Background) lit with a yellow wash and rim; text stays primary colour.
components.html: <button class="ds-toggle" aria-pressed="true"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 18 18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><rect x="2" y="5" width="11" height="9" rx="2"/><path d="M5 3h9a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v7"/></svg>Background</button>
components.css: .ds-toggle { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: #1d1d1f; font: 600 13.5px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toggle:hover { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.07); } .ds-toggle[aria-pressed="true"] { background: rgba(255,214,10,0.28); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px #FFD60A; } .ds-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFD60A; outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-toggle { color: #f5f5f7; } }

components.name: Hint Pill
components.description: A 40pt glass capsule with a yellow glyph that tells the user what to do next.
components.html: Drag to select an area, or click a window. Esc cancels.
components.css: .ds-hint { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; height: 40px; padding: 0 18px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.6); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.6); color: #1d1d1f; font: 500 13.5px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-hint { background: rgba(40,40,44,0.55); color: #f5f5f7; } }

components.name: Size Pill
components.description: Selection dimensions in SF Mono with a glowing yellow dot.
components.css: .ds-size { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 26px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); backdrop-filter: blur(24px); color: #1d1d1f; } .ds-size b { font: 600 12px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; } .ds-size small { font: 500 10.5px -apple-system, system-ui; opacity: 0.55; } .ds-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #FFD60A; box-shadow: 0 1px 9px rgba(255,214,10,0.5); } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-size { background: rgba(40,40,44,0.55); color: #f5f5f7; } }

components.name: Well with Slider
components.description: A grouped inset section on the inspector glass, holding yellow-tinted sliders with rounded value badges.
components.css: .ds-well { width: 272px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 18px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.05); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; color: #1d1d1f; } .ds-well-title { font: 600 12px -apple-system, system-ui; opacity: 0.55; } .ds-slider { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 400 12.5px -apple-system, system-ui; } .ds-slider span { width: 58px; } .ds-slider input { flex: 1; accent-color: #FFD60A; } .ds-slider input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFD60A; } .ds-slider output { min-width: 34px; padding: 3px 0; text-align: center; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.07); font: 600 11px ui-rounded, system-ui; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-well { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: #f5f5f7; } .ds-slider output { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07); } }

components.name: Gallery Tabs
components.description: Capsule track with a sliding tab pill that jumps the background gallery to a group.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 1px; padding: 3px; width: 272px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.06); } .ds-tab { flex: 1; min-height: 28px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: rgba(0,0,0,0.5); font: 500 11.5px -apple-system, system-ui; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.3s, color 0.3s; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #1d1d1f; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFD60A; } .ds-tab.ds-on { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); color: #1d1d1f; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.12); } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-tabs { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); } .ds-tab { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); } .ds-tab.ds-on { background: rgba(30,30,30,0.75); color: #f5f5f7; } }

components.name: Background Tile
components.description: A 44pt gallery swatch on 12pt; selected gets a yellow ring on 15pt, a check and the glow.
components.css: .ds-tile { width: 66px; padding: 3px; border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 15px; background: none; cursor: pointer; transform: scale(0.97); transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1); } .ds-tile.ds-on { border-color: #FFD60A; transform: scale(1); box-shadow: 0 2px 18px rgba(255,214,10,0.5); } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFD60A; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-swatch { display: block; height: 44px; border-radius: 12px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FDE68A, #F9A8D4, #F472B6); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.12); } .ds-swatch-b { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #38BDF8, #818CF8); }

components.name: Corner Card
components.description: Post-capture glass card: the shot leads at 20pt inside a 28pt card, with a 36pt action row.
components.css: .ds-card { width: 300px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 28px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.6); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.6), 0 12px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.22); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-shot { height: 200px; border-radius: 20px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #38BDF8, #818CF8); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.18); } .ds-row { display: flex; gap: 6px; height: 36px; } .ds-card-copy { flex: 1; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: linear-gradient(#FFE14D, #FFD60A, #F5C400); color: #000; font: 600 13px -apple-system, system-ui; box-shadow: 0 2px 18px rgba(255,214,10,0.5); cursor: pointer; } .ds-card-icon { width: 36px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); color: #1d1d1f; display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer; } .ds-card-icon:hover { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.08); } .ds-card-copy:focus-visible, .ds-card-icon:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFD60A; outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-card { background: rgba(40,40,44,0.55); } .ds-card-icon { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); color: #f5f5f7; } }

narrative.overview:
The capture overlay is native macOS Liquid Glass floating over the user's own frozen screen, with one glowing yellow control. It is generous and crafted rather than small: 40pt dock controls, a 50pt Copy button, a 300pt inspector with grouped wells, glass with a lit rim that catches light along its top edge. The screen, scrimmed at black 30%, is the backdrop; the bright rectangle the user dragged is the stage, framed in yellow crop marks.

Appearance follows the system. Glass is regular Liquid Glass on macOS 26 and later (`.regularMaterial` with a faint hairline before that), so the chrome is light on a light Mac and dark on a dark one; nothing is forced dark. Marker Yellow is the only accent colour in the chrome, and it is always lit: a gradient on the primary action, a soft yellow halo under whatever is on, a sliding yellow puck under the active tool, a yellow wash and rim on toggles. Everything else is glass, SF Symbols and system type.

What the user exports is a separate, expressive layer (wallpapers, mesh and gradient backgrounds, padding, corners, shadow, headings). The chrome stays native so the output can be the thing that shines. The Library and Settings are plain native macOS windows: system accent, standard controls, system text styles, no overlay styling.

The user rejected forced-dark smoked grey glass and small, dense shapes; this system replaces both.
keyCharacteristics: Native Liquid Glass with a lit rim, following the system appearance.
One accent, Marker Yellow, always lit (gradient, glow, puck, wash).
Generous targets: 40pt dock controls, 50pt Copy, 300pt inspector.
Concentric radii from the 30pt panel down to 12pt tiles; capsules everywhere else.
Spring motion: the puck slides, the tab pill slides, the toolbar springs in.
Library and Settings are plain native windows.

rules.name: The One Lit Colour Rule
rules.body: Marker Yellow is the only accent in the chrome. Other hues appear only as ink the user draws with, or as system status (the red recording dot, orange "lost track").

rules.name: The Always Lit Rule
rules.body: Yellow never sits flat: it carries a gradient, a halo (yellow at 50%, 9pt radius, 2pt down), or a rim. A flat yellow fill reads as a sticker, not a control.

rules.name: The Solid Primary Rule
rules.body: The primary action is a solid yellow gradient, never tinted glass, because glass tints grey out in a non-key overlay window.

rules.name: The Mono Means Measured Rule
rules.body: SF Mono appears only where the user reads pixels: the size pill and the loupe. Everything else is SF Pro or SF Pro Rounded.

rules.name: The Generous Target Rule
rules.body: Dock controls are 40pt, the dock primary is 50pt, card controls 36pt, the panel's shuffle button 36pt.

rules.name: The Glow, Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: An "on" control shows its state with a halo in its own colour, like a lit knob under glass. Dark drop shadows are only for lifting whole surfaces off the screen.

rules.name: The Concentric Rule
rules.body: An inner radius is its container's radius minus the inset between them. Never put a sharper inner corner against a softer outer one at random.

dos: Do use `glassChrome` for every overlay surface, so it gets Liquid Glass and the lit rim on macOS 26+ and `.regularMaterial` before.
Do let the appearance follow the system.
Do mark "on" with Marker Yellow plus a glow, a puck, or a wash and rim.
Do keep dock controls at 40pt and the dock primary at 50pt.
Do nest radii concentrically: 30 panel, 28 card, 18 wells, 12 tiles, capsules elsewhere.
Do group neighbouring glass in one `GlassGroup` so it blends as one surface.
Do animate state with springs, and slide a shared indicator (`matchedGeometryEffect`) rather than cross-fading.
Do keep Library and Settings plain native windows.
donts: Don't force the dark appearance or use smoked grey glass.
Don't shrink controls into dense, small instrument targets.
Don't introduce a second accent colour in the chrome; other hues are user ink or system status only.
Don't make the primary action tinted glass; it greys out in a non-key overlay.
Don't use SF Mono outside measurements.
Don't use dark drop shadows to show state; use the glow.
